column3: Description
column4: Acceptance Criteria

column3: OTP via FCM push notification, SMS fallback via Twilio.
column4:
• OTP delivered within 30 seconds
• Rate limiting enforced — max 3 attempts before lockout
• Attempt tracking stored server-side
• SMS fallback triggered if FCM fails

column3: JWT rotation with refresh token family management.
column4:
• Access token refreshed silently before expiry
• Logout invalidates all device tokens
• Refresh token family prevents reuse after rotation

column3: Update name, language preference, FCM push token.
column4:
• All fields validated server-side
• FCM token updated on each app launch

column3: CUSTOMER / DRIVER / ADMIN guards on all protected routes.
column4:
• CUSTOMER cannot access DRIVER or ADMIN endpoints
• DRIVER cannot access ADMIN endpoints
• Unauthorized requests return 403 with clear message

column3: Google Places API proxy with internal DB cache.
column4:
• Results returned within 2 seconds
• Repeated searches served from cache to reduce API cost
• Results limited to GCC markets

column3: save, list, edit, delete, set-default for delivery addresses.
column4:
• All CRUD operations return correct status codes
• Default address reflected in subscription delivery
• Deleted addresses cannot be used in new orders

column3: Returns state enum, days remaining, skip count, delivery count.
column4:
• State enum is always one of: NEW, ACTIVE, PAUSED, EXPIRED
• Days remaining calculated accurately
• Skip count reflects actual remaining skips

column3: Creates new subscription with plan type, start date, address.
column4:
• Only triggered after confirmed payment webhook
• Start date calculated correctly based on plan type
• Subscription state set to ACTIVE immediately

column3: Prorated cost, wallet credit offset, state transition.
column4:
• Prorated amount calculated correctly
• Wallet credit applied before charging gateway
• Subscription end date extended correctly on renewal

column3: Date range validation, max pause days, ACTIVE → PAUSED.
column4:
• Max pause days rule enforced server-side
• State transitions to PAUSED at correct start date
• Delivery records suspended for pause period

column3: Recalculate end date, PAUSED → ACTIVE, delivery re-schedule.
column4:
• End date recalculated to account for paused days
• State transitions to ACTIVE immediately on resume
• Delivery schedule reinstated from resume date

column3: Per-day meals with calorie data, salad flag, switch eligibility.
column4:
• Correct meals returned for each day of the week
• Calorie and allergen data accurate
• Switch eligibility flag reflects 6 PM lock state

column3: Whole plan or specific days switch within allowed window.
column4:
• Switch window validated server-side — blocked after 6 PM
• Whole-plan switch updates all future records
• Specific-day switch updates only selected days

column3: 6 PM lock via Redis, skip counter decrement, audit log.
column4:
• 6 PM lock enforced — skip rejected after cutoff
• Skip counter decrements atomically
• Audit log entry created for every skip
• Insufficient skip balance returns clear error

column3: Time-window validation, counter restore, delivery re-add.
column4:
• Undo only permitted within defined window
• Skip counter restored on successful undo
• Delivery record reinstated in schedule

column3: Per-day per-user salad add-on.
column4:
• Toggle state persisted per user per day
• Salad reflected in production sheet counts
• Toggle unavailable after 6 PM lock

column3: Paginated delivery history with calorie totals.
column4:
• Results paginated — max 20 per page
• Each entry includes meal name, date, calories, status
• Correct total calories per entry

column3: Aggregated meal counts per type for kitchen and admin.
column4:
• Counts accurate as of 6 PM lock each day
• Broken down by meal type
• Endpoint used by admin dashboard and label generator

column3: PENDING → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED with timestamp.
column4:
• Status transitions enforced in correct order only
• Timestamp recorded at each transition
• Driver GPS coordinates recorded on delivery

column3: Driver issue reporting with photo upload.
column4:
• Issue categories: Damaged, Missing, Wrong
• Photo upload to S3 presigned URL
• Issue appears in admin dashboard queue immediately

column3: Per-order label data for admin PDF generator.
column4:
• All required label fields returned: name, address, meal, date
• Endpoint returns accurate post-6 PM lock counts
• Consistent with production sheet data

column3: Star rating, optional photo, optional text note.
column4:
• Rating 1–5 accepted only
• S3 presigned URL generated for photo upload
• Rating visible in admin customer detail view

column3: Referral code, uses, and credits earned.
column4:
• Unique code per user confirmed
• Use count accurate
• Credits earned reflect actual referral completions

column3: Validate code on sign-up, credit both parties.
column4:
• Invalid or expired code returns clear error
• Referrer credited after referee completes first payment
• Referee credited at sign-up

column3: Gateway session creation with amount calculation.
column4:
• Session created with correct amount
• Plan linked to payment session
• Gateway session expires after 15 minutes

column3: Signature verification, idempotency key, subscription trigger.
column4:
• Signature verified before processing
• Idempotency key prevents double-processing on retries
• Subscription created/renewed only on confirmed payment
• Failed payment webhook returns 200 to gateway (no retry storm)

column3: Invoice list with PDF receipt generation via Puppeteer.
column4:
• All transactions returned in reverse chronological order
• PDF receipt generated per transaction
• Receipt PDF correctly formatted with order details

column3: Credit/debit transactions, balance API, referral credit.
column4:
• Balance always accurate — no race conditions on concurrent credit
• Each transaction has description, amount, timestamp
• Balance cannot go below zero
